fnol_text: My name is Dana Moreau and I live at 10 Maple Court, Madison, WI 53792. You can reach me on (555) 238-1815 or dana.moreau@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 18 February 2026, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2023-00110. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Moreau on (555) 238-1815 to acknowledge the claim. Dana confirmed the loss date as 18 February 2026.
Site visit to 10 Maple Court. Neighbour Marcus Santos was present and confirmed the timeline.
Dana sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
